expected_differences: The account initial and demo-creator identity correctly replace Maya’s fixture portrait and name. Preserve the stored identity and record names.
The four records show real workflow states: Request for you, Changes requested, Accepted and Installation next, rather than the Lab’s open discovery opportunities.
The actual amounts are $30.00, $75.00, $25.00 and $300.00. Their respective approval, approved-version and monthly bases remain visible.
Record-bound campaign and reference thumbnails correctly replace the Lab’s coffee-pour reference, Story poster and vehicle photograph.
To do 4, In review 1, History 1 and the unread utility counts reflect production state rather than fixture counts.
keep: The 200px graphite rail, restrained reversed TapMart mark, identity switcher and complete navigation hierarchy.
The mineral canvas, 32px main gutter, capped reading width, thin separators and absence of raised dashboard cards.

The compact Activity ledger rather than Home’s discovery compositions. These rows index existing work; adding a decorative 24px notch to every record would not create a meaningful source-to-commitment joint.
Contained, source-faithful thumbnails without fabricated vehicle imagery, playback controls or replacement media.
Right-aligned, bold monetary values with their conditions immediately underneath. Do not turn these operational amounts into oversized opportunity ledges.
Literal status words, short next-action instructions, restrained waiting/confirmed colors and cobalt selection edges.
review.readiness_note: Ready for visual release at 1440×900 with a minor desktop typography correction queued. The capture exposes the records, conditions, workflow tabs and navigation, but cannot establish whether row destinations, tab changes or mutations work.

drift.change: Set record task titles to IBM Plex Sans 500 at 18px/24px instead of the apparent 16px treatment. Set desktop tab labels to 16px/20px, weight 500 and 600 when selected, instead of the apparent 14px treatment. Retain 14px/20px metadata, status and payment-basis text, minimum 44px tab targets and the existing 24×3px selected edge. Allow row height to grow if a title wraps.
drift.why: Task titles and desktop tabs are slightly undersized relative to the approved operational scale. The rows remain readable, but task names are insufficiently differentiated from their supporting metadata.
drift.where: Activity tabs beneath the page title and the task-title line in all four records.

review.why: The production screen transfers the system rather than copying the unrelated phone Home layout: mineral working canvas, graphite identity/navigation, flat records, contained real media and disciplined color all survive. Each row exposes a named task, business, literal state and conditional amount without clipping or implying guaranteed earnings. All four records and the primary navigation fit comfortably in the captured viewport. The visible deviation is modest typography compression, not a broken composition or missing functional surface.
review.verdict: Frame Shift is faithfully translated into a compact desktop Activity ledger, with the real workflow visibly preserved and only minor type-scale drift.
